role: frequency-ordered word list (full list; the app bundles its head as the seed)
generationCommand: python gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang eu --script latin --stop "tom,mary,john,jim,mike,ken,sami,layla,jane,bill,bob,jack,maria,mari,tomek,tomen,tomi,tomekin,tomeri,tomas,laylak,laylaren,samik,samiren,samiri,samirekin,maryk,maryri,maryren,mariak,mariari,mariarekin,marik,mariaren" --out eu_words.txt eus_text.txt
transformations: gen-tatoeba-words.py: lowercased; tokens of the language's script letters plus an internal apostrophe / Catalan middle dot; Tatoeba placeholder names dropped (--stop); words seen fewer than 3 times dropped; ordered by count desc then first occurrence
no corpus sentence is redistributed - the file is a word list only
note: Tatoeba attests under ~2000 words for this language, so the app bundles the WHOLE list and offers no download.
